main_text.p: pietatem semel & iterum simulare nesci-verit vafer ille Hæresiarcha, ut voti compos fieret, & ad Episcopatum promove-retur; donec tandem detectâ illius fraude ac impostura de Ecclesiâ penitus eje-ctus est. Objicit Vir doctus quæ dicit Tertullianus advers. Valent. cap. 5. nempe Iustinum Philosophum & Martyrem scripsisse adversus Valentinum, Iustinus autem mortuus erat ante Eleutheri Pontificatum; fateor Tertullianum id de Iustino scripsisse, sed fieri potest ut idem Valentinus contra quem stilum exercuit Iusti-nus, orthodoxam postea fidem semel & iterum mentitus de Ecclesiâ sub Eleuthe-ro Papa bis ejectus sit: Si hoc dicis sibi constabit Septimius, nec hic diruet, quod alibi ædificavit.

Sed largiamur Eruditissimo Vindicia-rum Auctori, ad tempora Aniceti pervenisse Valentinum, neque diutius vixisse, nihil propterea proficiet, nec minus fru-stranei erunt illius adversus Blondellum conatus; Blondellus siquidem Præfat. in Apolog. pro Sentent. Hieron. pag. 45. 46. observat Valentinum non ante annum à martyrio Ignatij vel XL. vel XXXVI. Hæreticum agnitum esse, unde colligit ante eum annum refutari à quoquam non potuisse; propositionem suam probat Cla-XX.

page.notes: The margin note "XX." stands at the right beside the start of the second paragraph. "Cla-" is a word broken at the page end and continues on the next page; no catchword is printed. The numerals "45.46" and "5." appear in italic and are marked as such. Some long s forms (s) have been written as plain s, and the "f" in "advers." is read as long s, so it is written "advers.". The circumflex on the a in "Ecclesiâ", "detectâ" is kept as printed. The Google watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
